title: Severe Weather and Heat Alert in Georgia
text:
Trending Story
Updated 04:21 AM UTC, Thu June 26, 2025
Severe Weather and Heat Alert in Georgia
The high heat and humidity over the Eastern US continues for a 4th day and now we have growing instability in the hot humid air mass. The result is severe weather risks are increasing for Wednesday June 25 and Thursday June 26. The Storm Prediction Center is forecasting a 15 percent chance for severe thunderstorms in the Southeast US with just about the entire state of Gerogia in this zone. This includes the metro Atlanta area and all of its surrounding counties. Strong winds gusting past 55 mph and the risk for small hail look to be the greatest risks from these thunderstorms.
